backtest_protocol.execution_model: Signal uses only close-of-day OHLCV and sector-map industry membership available on the signal date. Industry breadth expansion and leader features are known after the signal close. Paper entry is next available open; exit is the close 10 trading days after signal with existing cost assumptions.
backtest_protocol.source: docs/backtesting.md canonical three-window core replay plus replay-only broad warehouse default-off paper overlay

hypothesis: candidate_pool alpha: when a PIT industry cohort shows internal breadth expansion and positive median short-term participation, a liquid leader in that cohort may capture synchronized sponsorship rather than generic single-name momentum.
negative_reflection: Industry breadth expansion did not add enough replacement value after next-open execution and accepted relation comparators. The field likely still relabeled crowded industry momentum rather than a distinct relation edge.

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retry by sweeping current/prior breadth fractions, SMA lookbacks, industry median return thresholds, leader strength thresholds, close-location, volume, hold-day, notional, cooldown, or top-N on these frozen windows.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: A valid retry needs materially new PIT flow/ownership/borrow/options evidence or forward replacement rows showing breadth expansion beats accepted industry relation helpers.
post_run_reflection.why_result_happened: Industry breadth expansion did not add enough replacement value after next-open execution and accepted relation comparators. The field likely still relabeled crowded industry momentum rather than a distinct relation edge.

pre_run_questions.1_alpha_hypothesis: candidate_pool alpha: when a PIT industry cohort shows internal breadth expansion and positive median short-term participation, a liquid leader in that cohort may capture synchronized sponsorship rather than generic single-name momentum.

2_history_check.exp-20260607-008: Accepted industry-relative laggard repair. This run is the leader side of synchronized breadth expansion, not laggard repair.
2_history_check.exp-20260608-008: Accepted stable industry core-flow. This run does not retune that helper; it tests breadth expansion without a same-day core-flow anchor.
2_history_check.exp-20260613-027: Rejected weak-industry scarce leader. This run tests the opposite relation: internal breadth broadening.
2_history_check.exp-20260614-028: Rejected multi-peer edge stability due old_thin/drawdown. This run uses industry breadth rather than peer-edge correlation.

pre_run_questions.4_acceptance_standard: Use docs/backtesting.md three canonical windows. Aggregate EV/PnL must be positive, no window EV/PnL regression, at least 20 paper trades across all 3 windows, survival >=5%, drawdown drift <=0.5pp, concentration pass, and accepted relation comparators beaten. Replay-only positives are leads until shared daily/backtest parity exists.

prediction.confidence_reason: Accepted relation alphas worked when industry or peer relation itself was the edge, while weak-cohort scarce leaders and generic OHLCV retunes failed; this tests the opposite relation, synchronized breadth expansion, using only PIT OHLCV and no production behavior change.

execution_envelope.failure_handling: missing OHLCV, next open, or 10d exit rejects the paper candidate
execution_envelope.kill_switch: trade_enabled remains false; no production changes
execution_envelope.liquidity_source: price >= $10 and ADV20 >= $50M from PIT OHLCV
execution_envelope.portfolio_displacement: none unless a later shared helper passes

production_impact.parity_note: This experiment changes no production code. A positive result is only a replay lead until a shared default-off helper computes the same industry grouping, breadth-expansion context, leader gates, cooldown, next-open paper entry, 10-trading-day exit, costs, and concentration controls in both historical replay and daily production observation.
